title: Farm Watch
question: How healthy are the crops of the Nile Delta, and how much water do they use?
description: Farmers need to know which fields are thriving and which are thirsty. Build a spacecraft that can see single fields from space.

source.title: NASA Landsat Science, Operational Land Imager
source.detail: 30 m imagery is described as sufficient to distinguish features such as urban centres, farms and forests. Budget, deadline and duration are scenario settings.

title: Storm Chasers
question: How much rain falls inside tropical storms?
description: Tropical storms bring floods. Build a spacecraft that can measure rain from above, even through thick cloud.

source.title: NASA Earth Science Reference Handbook (2006)
source.detail: TRMM mission and instruments, PDF p. 256-261. Budget, deadline and duration are scenario settings.

title: Ice Patrol
question: Are the polar ice sheets getting thinner?
description: The great ice sheets sit near the poles. Build a spacecraft that can measure the height of the ice, year after year.

source.title: NASA Earth Science Reference Handbook (2006)
source.detail: ICESat mission and GLAS, PDF p. 176-177. ICESat's 94 degree orbit reaches latitude 86 degrees. Budget, deadline and duration are scenario settings.
